transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this planning check-in for the spring musical. As we work through the production plan together, I want to make sure we address all the key details before I give my final approval. We have the draft plan in front of us — a Friday 7:00 p.m. performance, 220 audience seats, ordinary stage effects, and optional event recording. I'd like to hear from each of you about any concerns or adjustments you think we need to make before I sign off on the final plan and its operating conditions.

transcript.text: I need to flag an important issue before we finalize anything. The rights holder for one of the musical numbers in our production confirmed to me by email this week that we may only perform it after purchasing a live-performance license. Additionally, they stated that any audio or video recording of the production is prohibited. I haven't yet attached this email to the activity-approval file, but I'm sharing it now so we can address it. This directly affects the 'optional event recording' item in our draft plan — recording would not be permitted for this number.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share the results of the facilities inspection I completed this week. The auditorium may seat exactly 160 audience members for this production — not the 220 seats in the draft plan. Additionally, both marked side exits must remain clear. I haven't yet updated the draft seating plan to reflect this, but this capacity limit directly affects the draft plan's 220-seat proposal.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a health and safety concern. A cast member has a documented severe latex allergy, which I confirmed in the student's health record this week. This means all props and costume materials used in the production must be latex-free, and a staff member trained in the school's emergency-allergy protocol must be present at every performance. I haven't yet added this to the production file, but it's critical that we account for this before finalizing the plan.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to raise a critical scheduling issue. The district activity-bus coordinator confirmed that 12 participating students cannot reliably obtain evening transportation, and an activity bus is available for a Saturday 1:00 p.m. matinee. I've confirmed this with the affected families and the transportation office this week. This means the Friday 7:00 p.m. performance must be moved to the Saturday 1:00 p.m. matinee — not supplemented with an additional performance — so that all students can participate.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Attach the rights holder's email to the activity-approval file confirming live-performance license is required and recording is prohibited.
Update the draft seating plan to reflect the 160-person audience capacity and ensure both marked side exits remain clear.
Add the latex allergy documentation to the production file and ensure a staff member trained in the emergency-allergy protocol is present at the performance.
Confirm the Saturday 1:00 p.m. activity bus arrangement with the transportation office and affected families.
